observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Xbox controller, showing the D-pad, analog sticks, and ABXY buttons. The surface has visible scuffs and minor wear, especially on the left analog stick and around the D-pad. The Xbox logo is centered at the top.
Photo 1: Side view of the controller, showing the left grip and left analog stick. The left trigger is visible, and there is noticeable wear on the left grip and around the analog stick base.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the right side of the controller, showing the right trigger, USB-C port, and a small button (likely pairing). The surface shows scuff marks and minor scratches. The text 'XBOX' is faintly visible near the USB-C port.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HEVELAND'.

read_from: photo 0: Xbox logo and button layout

claims.claim: Clean used Xbox X series controller
claims.evidence: Photos show a black Xbox controller with the Series X design, including the USB-C port and button layout. The 'XBOX' text is visible in photo 2.

Photo 0 and photo 1 show visible scuffs, wear, and minor scratches on the analog sticks, D-pad, and grips. Photo 2 shows scuff marks on the top surface. These indicate use and not 'perfect condition'.

risks.risk: Controller may not function properly (e.g., sticky analog sticks, unresponsive buttons, or connectivity issues)
risks.proof: A video showing the controller being used to play a game, or a close-up of each button and stick being pressed and released.

risks.risk: Battery or charging issues (e.g., damaged USB-C port or non-functional battery)
risks.proof: A close-up of the USB-C port with a cable inserted, or a video showing the controller charging and turning on.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or internal wear (e.g., broken internal components, loose buttons)
risks.proof: A video showing the controller being pressed and used in various directions, or a disassembly video (if allowed by seller).

proof_requests: Video of the controller being used to play a game, showing all buttons and sticks working.
Close-up of the USB-C port with a cable inserted, showing charging.
Photo or video of the controller's back, showing any wear or damage to the battery compartment or triggers.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Xbox Series X controller. The seller's claim of 'perfect condition' is contradicted by visible wear in the photos. The item can be priced at its worst case (used with visible wear, possibly non-functional) until proof of working condition is provided. Hidden risks include functionality and charging issues, which are priced conservatively until proven.
